integrity: Symbolic verification and constructive if-and-only-if Lyapunov proof reproduced; finite numerical checks supplementary. Existing moment-generator methodology is acknowledged and no independent validation is claimed.
limitations: Only the equilibrium-centered linear Itô system with independent coordinatewise multiplicative noises is treated; no global stochastic nonlinear or sample-path stability is asserted.
title: Exact joint-noise mean-square stability boundary for a square-root predator–prey equilibrium
